entries.title: II Corinthians 5:1
segments: For I know, if this earthly tent of mine were struck, I have a mansion built by God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:2
segments: For in this tent I am groaning, earnestly longing to be under the cover of my heavenly habitation; if so be that being so covered,

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:3
segments: I shall not be found naked.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:4
segments: For in this tent of mine I am groaning in deep trouble; not that I wish to be unclothed, but to be clothed upon, that what is mortal may be swallowed up in life.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:5
segments: And He who has wrought me out for this very end is God, who has given me his Spirit as pledge.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:6
segments: Therefore I am always of good courage, because I well know that while I am at home in the body, I am in banishment from the Lord,

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:7
segments: for I am walking by faith, not by sight.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:8
segments: So I have good courage, and am well pleased rather, to be in banishment from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:9
segments: And for this reason I also make it home with the Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:10
segments: For we must all be made manifest, in our true characters, before the Judgment-seat of Christ; so that each one may receive according to that which he has done in his body, whether good or evil.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:11
segments: So, because I know the fear of God, I "persuade men." What I am is manifest to God, and I hope manifest also to your conscience.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:12
segments: I am not "commending myself to you again," but I am giving you an occasion of boasting on my behalf, so that you may have an answer ready for those who boast in externals, and not in the heart.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:13
segments: For if I was "beside myself," it was to God; of if I am now "of sound mind," it is for you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:14
segments: For the love of Christ overmasters me; because I thus judge that if One has died for all, then all have died;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:15
segments: and that he died for all in order that the living may live no longer for themselves, but for Him who died and rose again for them.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:16
segments: Therefore henceforth I know no one simply as a man--even if I have known Christ as a man, yet now I do so no longer.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:17
segments: So there is a new creation when any man is in Christ. The old life has passed away, behold, the new is come.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:18
segments: And all this is from God, who through Christ reconciled me to himself, and gave me the ministry of reconciliation;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:19
segments: how that God was in Christ reconciling a world to himself, not reckoning to men their trespasses; and that to me he has entrusted the message of that reconciliation.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:20
segments: On Christ's behalf, then, I come as ambassador. It is as though God was entreating you, through me, on Christ's behalf I beg you to be reconciled to God.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:21
segments: Him who knew no sin, in our behalf he has made to be sin; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
